evidence.title: GitHub - noelrohi/kd: Ad-free Kdrama streaming app

name: K-NEXT
summary: Ad-free Kdrama streaming app template with watchlist, episode tracking and an activity API.
description: Ad-free Korean drama streaming web app (K-NEXT) built with Next.js, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle ORM and NextAuth; streams come from the Consumet API. Features watchlists, episode tracking and an activity API, with comments marked as planned. MIT-licensed and self-hostable: copy the env file, run the Drizzle migrations and start on port 1999.
contains: watchlist, episode tracking and an activity API; comments planned
built with Next.js, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, NextAuth and the Consumet API
self-host with pnpm; dev server on port 1999
